description: S458 F1: an unknown named shape is refused at the DECLARATION in every zone, not only when the initializer is a literal. `let s: string(ssn) = v` has a non-literal (boundary-zone) initializer; before S458 it compiled clean to a runtime check of `if (!(true))` that admitted every value. It is now E-CONTRACT-002.
rationale: §53.6.3: "If a named shape identifier does not match any entry in the built-in or extended registry, the compiler SHALL emit E-CONTRACT-002 at compile time. Named shapes are resolved at compile time — there is no runtime shape lookup." The rule names no zone.
